settingsDescription: Choose your AI provider and configure it below.
apiKeyHint: Your key is stored on your device and never shared.
ollamaCloudApiKeyHint: Used to call Ollama Cloud via ollama.com. Create a key at ollama.com/settings/keys. Stored locally on your device.
openrouterApiKeyHint: Used to call OpenRouter via openrouter.ai. Create a key at openrouter.ai/keys. Stored locally on your device.
openaiApiKeyHint: Used to call the OpenAI API via api.openai.com. Create a key at platform.openai.com/api-keys. Stored locally on your device.
anthropicApiKeyHint: Used to call Claude via api.anthropic.com. Create a key at console.anthropic.com → Settings → API Keys. Stored locally on your device.
remoteUiDescription: Load the sidebar from the web so UI updates arrive without reinstalling the extension. Falls back to the built-in sidebar automatically when the hosted version cannot be reached.
remoteUiUrlHint: Leave empty to use the default. Only https:// origins are accepted; the sidebar reloads when this changes.
updateChannelHint: Which GitHub release the hourly update check and the sidebar bundle follow. Nightly builds carry whatever is on main.
updateExtensionUpToDate: The extension ({version}) is up to date.
updateExtensionAvailable: Extension update available: {version} — see the notification to download it.
uiBundleUpdate: Update the sidebar from GitHub releases ({channel})
uiBundleDescription: Downloads the sidebar UI of the selected channel's release into the extension and uses it instead of the built-in one. The hosted UI above takes precedence when it is enabled; Manifest V2 only. Files are verified against the release's hash manifest.
uiBundleNone: none — the built-in UI is used
uiBundleResultInstalled: UI bundle {version} downloaded; reopen the sidebar to use it.
uiBundleResultUpToDate: The downloaded UI bundle is up to date.
uiBundleResultNotAvailable: This release has no sidebar bundle yet.
uiBundleResultOlder: The release's UI bundle ({version}) is older than the installed extension; the built-in UI is used.
uiBundleCleared: Downloaded UI bundle removed; the built-in UI is used.
